note.en: Generated in the WorkBuddy harness with Hy4 as shown in the model selector and thinking intensity set to High. The Chinese case prompt from cases.json was used verbatim, one-shot, with no post-generation edits. No skill, plugin or MCP server was invoked and no custom system prompt was added. Only a read-only static check (TSX syntax parsing) before submission; artifact content unchanged. The artifact is a complete Three.js project: a 300-second timeline including titles and credits (under the 360-second hard limit), with ten voxel-block shots covering basement machining, the meeting hall debate, EVA, the vacuum shot and a debris epilogue. Twenty-two voice cues live in one structured manifest with the seven fields id / kind / speaker / text / delivery / start / end and directly drive the bottom-centred [speaker] subtitles. No human voice is synthesized; basement machining and reverberation, radio, suit breathing, thrusters and alarms are all synthesized at runtime with Web Audio, and the vacuum shot carries no airborne gunshot, only a suit-conducted thump. No external assets or CDNs are used. Dependencies were not installed and bun run build was not executed locally; only syntax parsing was performed.

note.en: Generated in the WorkBuddy harness with Hy4 as shown in the model selector and thinking intensity set to High. The Chinese case prompt from cases.json was used verbatim, one-shot, with no post-generation edits. No skill, plugin or MCP server was invoked and no custom system prompt was added. Only a read-only static check (TSX syntax parsing) before submission; artifact content unchanged. The artifact is a complete Vite project: a roughly 30-second explainer in six chapters showing the causal chain from the water tank to the bucket wheel, the gear train, the escapement, the striking puppets and the armillary sphere. Every mechanical motion is integrated in real time by an inline rigid-body dynamics solver (gravity torque on filled buckets, iterative velocity constraints for gear ratios, tooth-by-tooth escapement locking and impulse release, spring-damper integration for the puppets); no hand-keyed animation or directly set positions stand in for it, and only the camera and captions are timeline-driven. Music, drips, gear clicks and the hour chime are synthesized at runtime with Web Audio, with no audio or model asset files. The build config uses a relative base and fully inlined assets so dist/index.html runs offline. Dependencies were not installed and no production build was run locally; only syntax parsing was performed.
